snippet.title: If Enemy: SMACK! - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description: Take a look at the Reveal Trailer for If Enemy: SMACK!, an auto-battler strategy dungeon crawler RPG developed by MoxensGameDev. Players will assemble a party to solve puzzles within a suite of dungeons to run up the score in RNG-free auto-battles. If Enemy: SMACK! is coming soon to PC (Steam).
